name: Data Profiler
description: Profiles a dataset: one record per field with its type, missing and distinct counts, most common value and statistics, and the records with z-scores and anomaly flags for every numeric field.
introductoryText:
![](data:image/png;base64,
)

Profiles every field of the input, or the fields you choose, and scores each numeric value against its field.

**Fields** (first output): one record per field with its Omniscope type, the number of records, missing values (count and %), distinct values, the most common value and how often it occurs. Numeric fields also get the mean, standard deviation, minimum, quartiles, median, maximum, skewness and the number of anomalies; Date fields get the first and last date.

**Records** (second output): the input records with three fields added for each numeric field: `<field>_z_score` (how many standard deviations the value is from the field's mean), `<field>_anomaly` (1 when that distance is at least the threshold, else 0) and `<field>_p_value` (the chance of a value at least this far from the mean if the field were normally distributed). **Anomaly count** says how many of a record's values were flagged.

**How to set it up**: leave **Fields to profile** empty to profile every field, and set the **Anomaly threshold** (3 standard deviations by default). Boolean fields are counted but not scored. With fewer than 11 values a z-score cannot reach 3, so small inputs have no anomalies at the default threshold.

options.name: threshold
options.title: Anomaly threshold (standard deviations)
